svg.title: My path to Colorado State
svg.desc: A dotted route links Chico State, the University of Idaho, Washington State University, and Yale University, then returns to Chico State before continuing to Colorado State University. The Washington State and University of Idaho logos sit on opposite sides of the route.
svg.metadata: State boundaries: U.S. Census Bureau 2017, via U.S. Atlas (https://github.com/topojson/us-atlas). Logo sources appear in the slide notes.
